name: Rio de Janeiro
author: JGuylherme
description: Build a rail network across Greater Rio, from the iconic beaches of Copacabana and Ipanema to the sprawling Baixada Fluminense. Connect neighborhoods across Rio de Janeiro, cross Guanabara Bay to Niterói and São Gonçalo, and link communities throughout the wider metropolitan area.
data_source: IBGE Census 2022; IBGE PNAD Contínua (Q2 2026); IBGE CEMPRE (2024); RAIS (2023); OpenStreetMap; Overture Maps.
